name: meteor-falls
description: METEOR FALLS — an EarthBound-style RPG. Five kids, ten Embers, one planet at the end of the road.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && npm run validate && vite build
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npm run art:appart && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && .\gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && node tools/collect-apk.mjs
